needs: commands.test in .factory/sandbox/manifest.json is still null, so the tests gate runs nothing and the coverage gate finds no report. This PR adds the repo's first test runner and the first coverage report: `npm test` runs node's built-in test runner over test/ and writes coverage/lcov.info, which is one of the paths the coverage gate reads. The manifest needs commands.test set to `npm test` for either gate to see it. .factory/sandbox/** is protected, so I could not set it here.
why: Protected path: policy.yaml lists .factory/sandbox/** under paths.protected, and the gardening pipeline may change only code and tests. The capabilities.not_exercised entry 'Automated tests and total coverage' and the runbook's Test section both predict this exact amendment. Measured here with the new tests: src/handlers.js 100% of lines, src/server.js 82.6% (only the require.main listen block), 90.2% across src/.
